name: Coefficient Space of the Nonlinear Source-Domain Class
scope: The displayed $a,b,c,d$ are four positive-row ratios; the remaining eleven ratios are free.
proof: Only the retained positive system at source 30 constrains the ratios. Summing through its three inequalities gives necessity of $ab+cd>1$, and an explicit witness gives sufficiency. The coordinates $(ab+cd,ab/(ab+cd),a,c)$ identify the constrained factor with $(1,\infty)\times(0,1)\times(0,\infty)^2$.
